personality_one_liner: Command-center health tech with a deep obsidian canvas, high-contrast ember accent, and glanceable biometric telemetry.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm with compact modular spacing and 56pt touch targets.

do's: Use solid obsidian and graphite surfaces with high-contrast ember accents for maximum outdoor legibility.
Use crisp 1px borders (#2A2E3D) to separate telemetry cards.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur and translucent glass in dense health command centers where glanceability is critical.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Real-time health telemetry, live heart rate pulse, daily steps, activity summary, and ESP32-C3 BLE connection status.

states.loading: Centered pulse indicator with connecting status to EQOband...
states.empty: No EQOband connected. Tap scan to pair your ESP32-C3 wristband.
states.error: Bluetooth connection lost. Tap to retry reconnecting to EQOband.

screens.layout: Sticky status header at top with battery and BLE indicator, real-time live heart rate card with pulsating waveform, daily step progress ring/bar, activity summary breakdown, and quick action cards.

screens.name: Weekly Goals
screens.purpose: Comprehensive tracking of weekly step goals, activity milestones, and historical achievements.

states.loading: Loading weekly telemetry and streak data...
states.empty: No weekly activity records found yet. Complete workouts to populate trends.
states.error: Failed to load weekly metrics. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Summary banner at top with total weekly calories and step average, 7-day bar breakdown chart, milestone achievement list, and streak tracker.

screens.name: EQOAI
screens.purpose: AI health assistant with text chat, rule-based health insights, LLM responses, and voice interaction.

states.loading: EQOAI is analyzing your biometric data streams...
states.empty: Ask EQOAI anything about your heart rate, sleep recovery, or activity goals.
states.error: AI response timeout. Check connection and tap to retry.

screens.layout: Header with EQOAI status and voice assistant toggle, scrollable chat message history with rich insights, quick prompt pills at bottom, and persistent voice microphone trigger bar.

screens.name: Device & BLE
screens.purpose: Manage ESP32-C3 BLE pairing, view battery percentage, signal strength (RSSI), and connection controls.

states.empty: No nearby EQOband found. Ensure your wristband is powered on.
states.error: BLE scanning error. Enable Bluetooth and retry.

screens.layout: Connected device banner with real-time battery gauge, RSSI indicator, scan for devices list, firmware version, and disconnect/reconnect controls.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure user profile, notification preferences, goal targets, and app preferences.

states.error: Failed to save settings. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Grouped list rows with icon containers, toggle switches for notifications and haptics, demo profile info card, and app version metadata.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app uses Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK) with obsidian surfaces and warm ember accent (#FF5722). Implement real BLE connection flow mockup with ESP32-C3 service UUIDs, live heart rate pulse animation, EQOAI text and voice chat with audio simulation, weekly goals tracking, and demo profile. Follow all safety and native layout rules.
